PostgreSQL_0:
SELECT account_id
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT trans_id) >= 2
   AND (MAX(amount) - MIN(amount)) > 12000;
PostgreSQL_4:
UPDATE transactions_1k
SET amount = amount * 1.1 -- Example update: increase amount by 10%
WHERE custid IN (SELECT custid FROM customers WHERE segment = 'Mass Affluent') -- Example condition
-- Step 2: Join the updated row with the customers table in the RETURNING clause
RETURNING transactions_1k.transactionid, (SELECT c.segment FROM customers c WHERE c.custid = transactions_1k.custid) AS segment;
